stem.en: An oil company wants to drill under the sea, and fishing boats want rich waters. Which part of the sea floor suits both?

feedback.en: No. The slope is the steep drop at the true edge of the continent.
No. The plain is vast, flat and very deep, far from shallow water.
Yes. It is shallow, and rich in marine life and in oil and gas.
No. The ridge is a volcanic mountain range far out in the ocean.

explanation.en: The continental shelf is the shallow, submerged edge of a continent. It is rich in marine life and in resources like oil and gas. Mumbai High is an oil field on the shelf.

hints.en: Which part is shallow and lies just past the coast?
